ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two straight lines slanting upward to the right, and they are marked as parallel with identical pink arrows. Another straight line slanting downward to the right passes through these two parallel lines. ∠1 is located at the left intersection, and ∠2 is located at the right intersection; they are on the same side of this transversal line, and both are between the two parallel lines. Reasoning: It is known that m∠1 = 53°. For same-side interior angles formed by two parallel lines cut by a transversal, the sum of the angles is 180°, so m∠1 + m∠2 = 180°. Therefore m∠2 = 180° - 53° = 127°.
